prompt: Instrumental only cinematic orchestral film score for a three minute flight through the solar system. Vast and awe inspiring. A very quiet opening over the surface of the Sun, then a lift each time a new planet arrives, a hushed quiet bed each time the camera is low over a surface, and the biggest swell of the whole piece at the ending as the camera pulls back past Neptune and looks back at the whole system, thinning to one held note and silence. 60 BPM, D minor turning to D major at the end. No vocals, no choir.
